Motorcycle Transition Photochromic Lenses


🌞⛅🌙Motorcycle Transition Photochromic Lenses: Photochromic is the scientific term describing lenses that darken when exposed to UV rays. Transitions is a brand of photochromic lenses. Choose from two lens colors. Bikershades offers 2 colors:  lenses that will be clear at night and change to grey under the sun; or yellow lenses that turn to a rustic brown. No need to pack multiple sunglasses for day and night riding; or stop on the side of the road to change lenses.

CLEAR TO GREY: Lenses darken to a nice grey tint when exposed to UV rays or sunlight. At night, the lenses change to clear. Lens change color in seconds and always provide 100% UV protection. Clear lenses allow the most light to enter the eye. Grey lenses provides the most natural color and the most popular for sunglasses.

YELLOW TO BROWN: Lenses darken to a nice rustic brown when exposed to UV rays or sunlight. At night, the lenses change to yellow. Yellow lenses reduce the halo effect around lights at night and also increase contrast. Yellow lenses are often used for target sports. Brown lenses increases clarity by blocking out the blue light in the UV spectrum. Brown lenses are often used by golfers so they can see the golf ball hundreds of yards away. Lenses always provide 100% UV protection.
